reviews.review:
Risk of Rain, besides having an awesome name, offers up a vicious action platform / rogue-like game that will test your patience but also keep you coming back to try again. 

You are dropped in a level and must kill enemies to gain experience and money, eventually finding a teleporter to be taken to the next level. Money is used on shrines and chests. Both of which may give you an item to help you. These are permanent (until you die) character buffs that also stack. So with enough time, your character can be decked out. Time is also your enemy. The longer you live the harder the game gets.

Risk of Rain is tough. Death is permanent and you must start over each time you die. It can be frustrating but you get better over time. 

I wasn’t very good at this game and couldn’t get past the first level. I activated a portal and couldn’t kill the boss and surrounding enemies without dying. So I’m not sure what else the game offered in the other levels. 

I wish there was more than 1 character unlocked from the beginning. It got a stale fairly fast with not being able to test out another character with different attacks and strategy. 

[b]Pros[/b]
+60FPS
+Nice pixel art
+Difficult but has you coming back for more
+Co-op available
+Good soundtrack

[b]Cons[/b]
+Luck based item drops (can have a terrible or amazing playthough)
+1 Character to start with

  I feel like this would be most enjoyable playing with a few friends. However, I did enjoy playing this alone for a short time. 

[b]6/10[/b] Above average
